# Configuration and exceptions

Settings are read from environment variables and a configuration file; errors derive from one base class so a single
`except PyGeoVisionError` catches everything the package raises on purpose.

**Explained in:** [Configuration reference](../config.md) · [Exceptions reference](../exceptions.md)

This page documents **41 public classes and functions** in 2 modules.

## `pygeovision.core.config`

PyGeoVision Configuration.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `GPUConfig` | class | GPU/compute device configuration. |
| `TrainingDefaultsConfig` | class | Default training hyperparameters. |
| `ModelHubConfig` | class | Model hub / checkpoint cache configuration. |
| `PyGeoFetchConfig` | class | PyGeoFetch pass-through configuration. |
| `PyGeoVisionConfig` | class | Complete PyGeoVision configuration. |

## `pygeovision.core.exceptions`

PyGeoVision-specific exception hierarchy.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `PyGeoVisionError` | class | Base exception for all PyGeoVision errors. |
| `PyGeoVisionConfigError` | class | Raised for invalid or missing configuration. |
| `PyGeoVisionAuthError` | class | Raised when authentication with a provider fails. |
| `AIEngineError` | class | Base class for all AI engine errors. |
| `AINotAvailableError` | class | Raised when AI dependencies are not installed. |
| `GPUError` | class | Raised for GPU/CUDA-related errors. |
| `OutOfMemoryError` | class | Raised when GPU or CPU runs out of memory during model operations. |
| `DatasetError` | class | Raised for dataset preparation or loading errors. |
| `TilingError` | class | Raised when the tiling engine fails. |
| `AugmentationError` | class | Raised for augmentation pipeline errors. |
| `PreprocessingError` | class | Raised for image preprocessing errors. |
| `LabelingError` | class | Base class for labeling errors. |
| `OSMLabelingError` | class | Raised for OpenStreetMap labeling failures. |
| `BuildingFootprintError` | class | Raised when building footprint data cannot be retrieved. |
| `SAMLabelingError` | class | Raised for SAM (Segment Anything Model) labeling errors. |
| `FoundationModelLabelingError` | class | Raised for foundation model pseudo-label generation errors. |
| `ModelError` | class | Base class for model-related errors. |
| `ModelNotFoundError` | class | Raised when a requested model is not in the registry. |
| `ModelDownloadError` | class | Raised when a model weight download fails. |
| `ModelLoadError` | class | Raised when a model cannot be loaded from disk. |
| `ModelExportError` | class | Raised during model export (ONNX, TorchScript, TensorRT). |
| `ArchitectureError` | class | Raised for unsupported or misconfigured architecture specifications. |
| `TrainingError` | class | Base class for training errors. |
| `CheckpointError` | class | Raised for checkpoint save/load failures. |
| `DistributedTrainingError` | class | Raised for multi-GPU / distributed training errors. |
| `LossError` | class | Raised for loss function errors (NaN, Inf). |
| `InferenceError` | class | Base class for inference errors. |
| `TiledInferenceError` | class | Raised for tiled inference failures. |
| `PostProcessingError` | class | Raised for prediction post-processing failures. |
| `VectorizationError` | class | Raised when raster-to-vector conversion fails. |
| `PipelineError` | class | Base class for end-to-end pipeline errors. |
| `PipelineConfigError` | class | Raised for invalid pipeline configuration. |
| `PipelineStepError` | class | Raised when a specific pipeline step fails. |
| `MonitoringError` | class | Raised for model monitoring errors. |
| `DriftDetectionError` | class | Raised for data drift detection failures. |
| `ExperimentError` | class | Raised for experiment tracking errors. |
